component.name: Exegol
component.summary: Run AI coding agents side by side

description.p: Exegol runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Aider or any CLI coding agent side by side, each in its own terminal, with live status, one place to see which agent needs you, and tools to hand work between them.

ul.li: 14 built-in agent CLIs plus your own, each in a real terminal
Tabs and split panes per project, and a dashboard across projects
Sessions that keep running through a reload, a crash or an update
Browser pane, git diff and a smart commit, push and pull request button
